blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
3D vision transformers such as VGGT predict camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images in a single forward pass, but their global attention over all concatenated view tokens dominates computation as the number of views grows.
To reduce this cost, SparseVGGT and HeSS sparsify attention at the block level, and both retain blocks with high attention probability.
However, we observe that attention probability poorly predicts how much the model’s behavior actually changes when a block is removed, and we show that this mismatch is why performance collapses as sparsity increases.
In this paper, we propose ReSS (ReSidual-ReStoring Sparse Attention), which recasts block selection from a problem of maximizing the retained attention mass to one of minimizing the drift that sparsification leaves in the residual stream.
We introduce a drift score that quantifies how much each block shifts the residual, and, since the drift of a drop set depends on the directions of the contribution vectors rather than on their magnitudes alone, an iterative residual restoration procedure that refines the drop set as a whole.
Across three backbones and five datasets, ReSS preserves dense performance better than prior methods at matched sparsity. Two further results support drift as the quantity that governs the cost of sparsification: maximizing drift degrades performance faster than random selection, and plotted against realized drift instead of sparsity, all methods fall approximately onto a single curve.
Code is available at https://github.com/libary753/ReSS .

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D vision transformers (3D ViTs) such as VGGT [ 24 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 26 ] , and DepthAnything3 [ 13 ] predict camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images in a single forward pass. This capability comes from global attention over the concatenated tokens of all views. For the same reason, however, the attention cost grows quadratically with the number of views and dominates the overall computation precisely when many views are processed at once.
blocks.zh: 3D视变器(3D ViTs),如VGGT [24],π 3\pi^{3}[26],和DepthAnything 3[13] 预测相机的姿势和场景几何从一个单向前传的多视图图像中. 这一能力来自全球对各种观点的凝聚象征的关注。 然而,出于同样的原因,注意力成本随着观点数量增长四倍,并在同时处理许多观点时,在总体计算中占据主导地位.

blocks.en: A common remedy is sparse attention: only a small fraction of query–key pairs contribute meaningfully to the output, so the rest can be skipped with little change; for practical speedups, the skipping is done at the block level. The question is then how to identify the blocks to keep. For 3D ViTs, SparseVGGT [ 23 ] first applies block-sparse attention on a pooled block-level attention map, and HeSS [ 11 ] adds head-wise budget allocation. Both select them based on attention-probability magnitude, and both degrade rapidly as sparsity increases.
blocks.zh: 一个常见的补救措施是很少注意:只有一小部分的查询 - 键对对输出有有意义的贡献,所以其余的可以略作修改跳过;对于实际速度,跳过是在块级完成的. 那么问题是如何识别要保存的区块。 对于3D ViTs,SparseVGGT [23]首先在集合区块级关注地图上应用块-sparse关注,HeSS [11] 增加了头端预算分配. 两者都根据注意力概率的大小选择它们,两者都随着痉挛的增大而迅速降解.

blocks.en: We trace this degradation to probability-based selection itself. When we directly measure how much the attention output changes upon removing a block, attention probability turns out to be a poor predictor of the ranking. The rank correlation fluctuates widely across layers and heads, dropping to near-random in later layers ( Sec. 3 ). In other words, existing methods decide what to keep without looking at the very quantity they aim to preserve: what attention writes into the residual stream. We call the shift that sparsification leaves there the residual drift (Fig. 1).
blocks.zh: 我们追踪这种退化 以概率为根据的选择本身。 当我们直接测量注意输出在移除一个块时会改变多少时,注意概率就会证明是排名的差的预测者. 等级关联在层和头之间波动很大,在后层下降至近随机(sec.3 . 换句话说,现有方法在不考虑它们所要保留的数量的情况下决定保持什么:注意的内容会记录在剩余流中。 我们把垃圾邮件的转移称为残余漂移(图1)。

blocks.en: We propose ReSS ( ReS idual- ReS toring S parse Attention). ReSS recasts block selection as a set selection problem: find the block set that minimizes this drift. We introduce a drift score that quantifies how much removing each block shifts the residual. However, the drift of a drop set depends on the directions of the contribution vectors, not only on their magnitudes, so we pair the score with an iterative residual restoration procedure that refines the drop set as a whole. Each restoration round is fused into a single kernel to suppress its overhead.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ReSS(ReS idual-ReS toring S 剖析注意). ress将块选择重制成一组选择问题:找到可以最小化此漂移的块集. 我们提出一个漂移分数 以量化每个区块的去除量 将剩余部分转移 然而,一个掉落集的漂移取决于贡献矢量的方向,而不仅仅取决于其体积,所以我们用一个迭代的剩余恢复程序来配对掉落集整体. 每个恢复回合被熔化成一个单一的内核以压制其俯冲.

blocks.en: Across three backbones and five datasets, and against baselines that include selection criteria ported from long-context LLM prefill and video diffusion, ReSS preserves dense performance best at matched sparsity. Moreover, maximizing drift by flipping the sign of the objective collapses performance faster than random selection. Re-plotted against the realized drift of each method rather than sparsity, performance falls approximately onto a single curve across methods.
blocks.zh: 在3个主干线和5个数据集中,对照包括从长文本 LLM 预填和视频传播中移植的选择标准在内的基线,ReSS最能保持相对应的密集性能。 此外,通过翻转目标标志来最大化漂移,其性能比随机选择更快. 相对于每种方法的实现漂移,而不是伸缩性,性能大约落在一个跨方法的单一曲线上。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We show that attention probability poorly predicts the output change caused by block removal, and recast block selection as minimizing residual drift over block sets. • We introduce a drift score for single-block removal and iterative residual restoration that reduces the cumulative drift of the drop set. • Across three 3D ViT backbones and five datasets, our method best preserves dense performance, in comparisons that include sparse attention methods designed for LLMs and video diffusion as well as for 3D ViTs. • A sign-flipped control experiment and the collapse of performance onto a single curve as a function of drift support drift as the quantity that determines the cost of sparsification.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent 3D ViTs replace multi-stage geometry pipelines [ 15 ] with a single feed-forward transformer that regresses camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images [ 25 , 24 , 26 , 13 ] , at the cost of global attention over the concatenated tokens of all views. Token merging and pruning [ 2 , 17 , 19 , 4 ] reduce the number of tokens entering attention, and architectural approaches replace attention with linear-time recurrence [ 33 , 3 ] or chunked processing [ 5 ] at the cost of retraining or pipeline changes; sparse attention instead reduces the attention call itself, runs on released weights, and is complementary to token reduction.
blocks.zh: 最近的三维 ViTs将多级几何管道[15]替换为单一的Feed-forward变压器,该变压器将相机的姿势和场景几何从多视图图像[25,24,26,13]中退后,而代价是全球关注所有视图的凸现符号. Token合并和挤压[2,17,19,4]减少进入注意的符号数量,建筑方法以线性时间重现[33,3]或块状处理[5]取代注意,代价是再培训或管道改变;注意力稀少反而减少注意本身,运行在释放的重量上,是对减少符号的补充.

blocks.en: Block-sparse attention, developed for long-context LLM prefill [ 10 , 20 , 31 , 28 , 12 ] and extended to video diffusion [ 27 , 29 , 32 ] , computes exact attention over a selected subset of key blocks, and selection has relied on fixed structural patterns [ 10 , 27 ] , attention probability mass [ 20 , 31 , 28 , 12 ] , or the dispersion of attention logits within a block [ 32 ] . For 3D ViTs, SparseVGGT [ 23 ] keeps blocks with large mass on a pooled block-level attention map via top- k k and top- p p criteria, and HeSS [ 11 ] redistributes block budgets across heads. Whatever the domain, these criteria are statistics of the attention call itself.
blocks.zh: 块状散射注意,是为长文本 LLM 预填 [10, 20, 31, 28, 12] 开发的, 并扩展到视频传播 [27, 29, 32] , 计算出对一些选定的关键块的精确注意, 选择依赖于固定的结构模式 [10, 27], 注意概率 [20, 31, 28, 12], 或注意日志在块内分散 [32] 。 对于 3D VITs, SparseVGGT [23] , 通过顶- k 和顶- p 标准在集合块级注意图上保留了大块质量的块, HeSS [11] 将块预算重新分配到头。 不论所涉领域如何,这些标准都是关注本身的统计数字。

blocks.en: To our knowledge, the closest attempts to score removal by its effect on the output come from KV cache eviction, where recent methods rank each token by the change its eviction induces in the attention output [ 7 , 9 , 6 , 8 ] . These scores remain per-token and stop at the attention output; ReSS minimizes the drift of the drop set as a whole, measured in the residual stream.

blocks.en: 3 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3 动机

blocks.en: For 3D ViTs, SparseVGGT [ 23 ] and HeSS [ 11 ] adopt block-sparse attention, which proceeds in three steps: (1) queries and keys are partitioned into fixed-size blocks, and mean pooling within each block yields a coarse block-level attention map; (2) for each query block and head, key blocks are selected based on this map, up to a per-head budget c h c_{h} ; (3) exact attention is computed only over the selected blocks, with softmax renormalized among them, so the output behaves as if the unselected blocks never existed. Special tokens such as camera and register tokens aggregate global information and are excluded from sparsification [ 23 ] . The block layout of step (1) also affects the approximation [ 29 ] , but given a layout, its quality is governed by step (2): which blocks to keep. This selection criterion is the subject of this paper.
blocks.zh: 对于3D ViTs,SparseVGGT [23] 和 HeSS [11] 采用块分隔注意,分三个步骤进行:(1) 查询和键被分割成固定大小的块,每个块内意味着集合产生粗细的块级注意图;(2) 对于每个查询块和头,关键块根据这个地图进行选择,最高为人均预算c h_{h};(3) 精确的注意只计算在选定的块上,其中软马克斯重归正态,所以输出表现得好像没有选择的块永远不存在一样. 相机和注册信使等特殊信使汇总全球信息,被排除在斯帕西化之外[23]. 步(1)的区块布局也会影响近似值[29],但鉴于其布局,其质量由步(2)规范:哪些区块需要保留. 这一选择标准是本文件的主题。

blocks.en: Existing methods, including SparseVGGT and HeSS, uniformly select blocks by attention probability. This choice carries an implicit assumption: the less attention a block receives, the less the model’s output changes when it is removed. The assumption is typically taken for granted, and the criterion has rarely been explored beyond probability.
blocks.zh: 包括SparseVGGT和HeSS在内的现有方法,统一按照注意概率选择块. 这种选择带有一个隐含的假设:一个块得到的注意越少,模型在被移除时输出的变化就越少. 这种假设通常被认为是理所当然的,而且这一标准很少被超出概率加以探讨。

blocks.en: We put this assumption to the test by directly measuring the change that masking a single block induces. For each candidate block, we run two forward passes, one with dense attention and one with only that block masked, and take the difference between the resulting attention outputs after the output projection. The magnitude of this difference, a Euclidean norm over the query tokens of the block, is our reference: it is the change that masking actually leaves in the residual stream, measured at token resolution, and its definition involves no selection criterion. We then compare the ranking assigned by attention probability against the ranking induced by this reference, computing the Spearman rank correlation for every (query block, head) pair on six DTU [ 1 ] scenes with twelve views each.
blocks.zh: 我们通过直接测量掩盖一个街区诱导的变化来测试这个假设。 对于每个候选区块,我们先行运行两张通行证,一张有浓厚的注意力,一张只有遮盖的通行证,并在产出预测后将由此产生的关注产出加以区别。 这种差异的大小,是欧几利得规范在区块的查询符上的一个标准,是我们参考的:正是这种变化掩盖了实际上在剩余流中留下的,以符号分辨率衡量,它的定义不涉及选择标准. 然后,我们将根据注意力概率分配的排名与这个参考所引发的排名进行比较,计算出Spearman在六个DTU [1]场景上每对(凯里区块,头)的排名关联,每个场景有12个视图.

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows that attention probability fails to consistently predict this ranking. At layer 18, head 0, its rank correlation is only 0.29 0.29 ; across layers, the correlation fluctuates widely and approaches or even falls below random selection in later layers. Attention probability is thus an incomplete proxy for block importance.
blocks.zh: 图2显示,注意概率未能一致预测这一排名。 在第18层,头部0,它的阶次关联性只有0.290.29;跨层,关联性波动很大,在后层接近甚至低于随机选择. 因此,注意概率对于块重要性来说是一个不完整的代称.

blocks.en: Since probability fails to predict the change, we take the change itself as the objective. Block masking changes only what the attention sublayer adds to the residual stream; the entire cost of sparsification is a shift in this contribution. We call this shift the residual drift . Writing the pre-LN structure as x ℓ + 1 = x ℓ + f ℓ ​ ( x ℓ ) x_{\ell+1}=x_{\ell}+f_{\ell}(x_{\ell}) , with x ℓ x_{\ell} the input to layer ℓ \ell and f ℓ f_{\ell} its sublayer, the drift injected at layer ℓ \ell propagates as a change in the input to every subsequent layer. To keep the output of the sparse model close to that of the dense model, block selection should therefore minimize the residual drift. This is the selection objective of this paper.

blocks.en: The initial selection of Eq. 7 evaluates each block independently. blocks.en: Each restoration round launches many small operations over ( n h , q blk , k blk ) (n_{h},q_{\mathrm{blk}},k_{\mathrm{blk}}) tensors; each is cheap in FLOPs but incurs a separate round trip to memory, so the round is bound by memory bandwidth rather than computation. blocks.en: We evaluate on three feed-forward 3D ViTs: VGGT [ 24 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 26 ] , and DepthAnything3 [ 13 ] . blocks.en: Our main baselines are SparseVGGT [ 23 ] and HeSS [ 11 ] , the block-sparse attention methods proposed for 3D ViTs. We additionally port six sparse attention methods from other domains to VGGT: XAttention [ 28 ] , SpargeAttn [ 31 ] , and FlexPrefill [ 12 ] from LLM long-context prefill, and SVG [ 27 ] , SVG2 [ 29 ] , and SVG-EAR [ 32 ] from video diffusion. The LLM methods share our block configuration and kernel, differing only in the selection criterion; the video methods keep their own block layouts ( Sec. F , Sec. G ).

Each scene is evaluated on all of its frames, subsampled to at most 100 100 : HiRoom has 10 10 – 23 23 views, ETH3D 14 14 – 76 76 , DTU 49 49 , and ScanNet++ and 7-Scenes reach the cap. blocks.en: Video diffusion appears the closer neighbor, as both consume long token sequences from many images, yet the transfer fails on two counts. First, the assumptions do not carry: the fixed bands of SVG assume adjacent frames share nearly the same scene, but adjacent views are much farther apart even on ScanNet++, where the view order follows a capture trajectory, and SVG reaches dense quality at no operating point. Second, the costs do not amortize: the clustering of SVG2 and SVG-EAR carries over, and SVG-EAR retains dense quality even at high sparsity, yet both run slower than dense attention, since re-planning the block layout at every layer is a fixed cost that diffusion spreads over tens of denoising steps and a single forward pass pays in full ( Sec. G ).

blocks.en: Each row tests one claim. blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We recast block selection in 3D vision transformers, from keeping blocks with high attention probability to minimizing the drift that sparsification leaves in the residual stream. ReSS realizes this with a drift score for single-block removal and iterative residual restoration that reduces the cumulative drift of the drop set. Across three backbones and five datasets, ReSS preserves dense performance better than prior methods at matched sparsity; flipping the sign of the objective shows that this gain comes from the drift criterion itself, and performance across methods collapses onto a single curve as a function of the drift each leaves. Sparsity says how much attention is skipped; the drift left in the residual stream says what that skipping costs, and selection should be designed, and perhaps evaluated, in that currency.
blocks.zh: 我们用三维视变压器重塑区块选择, 从保持区块的高度注意概率, 到最小化螺丝化在残余流中的漂移。 ReSS通过单块清除和迭代剩余还原的漂移得分来意识到这一点,从而减少了掉落集的累积漂移. 在整个三个主干线和五个数据集中,ReSS比以往的方法更好地保存了密密的性能,对应的sparsity;翻转目标标志显示,这一增益来自漂移标准本身,不同方法的性能作为漂移每个叶片的函数会倒塌在一个单一曲线上. Sparsity说漏掉了多少注意力;残余流中留下的漂移说出什么跳过成本,选择应该用这种货币来设计,也许应该加以评价。

blocks.en: A Limitation
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The objective of ReSS is to minimize drift from the dense computation, and this takes the dense output as an attainable ceiling. The experiments show that the premise does not always hold ( Sec. B.2 ). In some cases sparsification improves on dense, which means that the drift introduced at the selection step can act, as it passes through the subsequent layers of the model, in a direction that raises quality. The current formulation addresses only the magnitude of drift and does not ask whether its direction is beneficial or harmful, so ReSS stays near the dense result by design and forgoes these gains. Distinguishing beneficial from harmful drift at selection time, that is, sparsification that improves on the dense computation rather than restoring it, is worth pursuing as future work.
blocks.zh: ReSS的目标是尽量减少从密集计算中漂移,这把密集输出作为可实现的上限. 实验表明前提并非总能维持(Sec.B.2.). 在某些情况下,溅射在密集度上有所改进,这意味着在选择步骤上引入的漂移,在穿过模型的后续层时,可以向提高质量的方向发展. 目前的提法只涉及漂移的幅度,并不问其方向是有益还是有害,因此ReSS通过设计而保持在密集结果附近,并放弃这些收益. 将选择时间与有害漂移区分开来是有好处的,也就是说,可以改进密集计算而不是恢复计算,因此值得作为今后的工作来进行。

blocks.en: C Dense Alignment for Precise Evaluation
blocks.zh: C. 精确评价的理智一致

blocks.en: DA3-Bench [ 13 ] aligns the predicted geometry to the ground truth with a Sim(3) transform, estimated by a Umeyama fit [ 22 ] to the camera centers of the scene. This gives only as many samples as there are cameras ( 49 49 on DTU [ 1 ] ): as sparsity grows and a few poses go badly wrong, those few dominate the fit, and the measured degradation mixes degraded geometry with failed alignment , changing the shape of the performance curve over sparsity.
blocks.zh: DA3-Bench [13] 将预测的几何学与地面的真理与Sim(3)的变迁相配合,由Umeyama人估计与现场的摄像中心合 [22]. 这只给出了和有相机一样多的样本(DTU[1]上的49 49):随着孢子生长,少数姿势出现严重错误,这些少数的姿势主导了适配,而测量的降解将退化的几何结构与失败的对齐混合在一起,使性能曲线的形状改变于孢子.

blocks.en: We therefore estimate the transform from pixel-wise depth correspondences. Unprojecting the predicted and ground-truth depths, with validity masks from the backbone’s own confidence threshold, makes each pixel its own correspondence, yielding tens of millions of pairs per scene and diluting the influence of a few wrong poses accordingly. We run the Umeyama fit on these pairs, trim the top quantile of residuals once, and refit, which keeps regions of collapsed geometry from dragging the global transform. The procedure is applied identically to every method and every sparsity level, and the same alignment enters the head importance calibration of HeSS ( Sec. D ): the entire paper uses one definition of alignment.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们估计从像素深度对应的变化。 无法预测预测和地面真实的深度,加上从骨干本身的信心阈值中发出的有效性面具,使每个像素都能够进行自己的对应,每个场景产生数千万对,并相应削弱少数错误的影响。 我们运行的 Umeyama 适配这些对, 修剪一次顶级的残基, 并修复, 防止几何学崩溃的区域 拖动全球变换。 该程序在应用上与每一种方法及每个sparsity级别相同,同样的对齐进入HeSS的头部重要性校准(Sec. D):整张论文使用一个对齐的定义.

blocks.en: E Fused Kernel Implementation
blocks.zh: E 引信内核执行

blocks.en: One restoration round consists of computing the restore/drop gains Eqs. 14 and 15 , masking against the inside and outside of the drop set, exact top- m m selection for restores and for drops, and updating the drop set and the scalars G G and K K . Each is a cheap operation over an ( n h , q blk , k blk ) (n_{h},q_{\mathrm{blk}},k_{\mathrm{blk}}) tensor, but each incurs its own round trip to memory, so the round is bound by bandwidth rather than computation. We therefore fuse all of the above into a single Triton kernel. Each query row is processed in registers in one sweep, from gain computation to the drop-set update, with no intermediate tensor written to memory and only the new drop mask written out. The GEMM behind the inner-product term of the gains stays outside the kernel, taking the cuBLAS output as is. The effect of fusion is reported in the w/o fused kernel row of Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: 一个恢复回合包括计算恢复/投放收益Eqs 14和15,对投放集的内外遮掩,精确的恢复和投放的顶-m m选择,以及更新投放集和Scalars G G和K K K. 每一个都是在一个(n h, q blk, k blk) (n_{h}, q_{\mathrm{ blk}}, k_{\mathrm{ blk}}) 数位器上进行廉价的操作,但每个都进行自己的回程内存,所以圆是受带宽而不是计算束缚的. 因此,我们把以上所有内容整合成一个三联体内核。 每个查询行在一次扫码中处理,从增益计算到滴集更新,没有中间的朗诺写到内存,只有新滴掩码写出. 收益内产期背后的GEMM留在内核之外,将cuBLAS输出照原样. 聚变的效果在Tab的w/o熔化内核行中报告. 1 (英语).

This identity holds within the supported configurations; outside them, the implementation falls back to the unfused path. The cap k blk ≤ 4096 k_{\mathrm{blk}}\leq 4096 comes from holding one row in registers, corresponds to about 253 253 views, and is conservative; every experiment in this paper is within this range.

blocks.en: F Porting LLM Sparse Attention Baselines
blocks.zh: F 移植 LLM 分散注意力基线

blocks.en: The three methods replace only the mask-construction step and share everything else with our method: the same grid of query blocks of 128 128 and key blocks of 64 64 , the same block-sparse kernel, the same sink rule that always keeps the trailing block holding the special tokens, the same floor of at least two key blocks per query row that applies to every method in the paper, and the same definition of measured sparsity. The always-keep rules that each method defines in its own paper are kept on top. All three set their budget through a threshold, so for each of our grid points we pre-measure, on a subset of scenes, the threshold whose measured sparsity comes closest, and fix it; the maximum residual from the target sparsity is 0.023 0.023 .
blocks.zh: 这三种方法只取代了面具-构建步骤,用我们的方法分享其他一切:相同的查询区块的网格为128 128,关键区块为64 64,相同的区块-sparse内核,相同的沉积规则总是让跟踪区块持有特殊符牌,每个查询区块至少有两个关键区块的同一层,适用于纸张中的每一方法,测量的痉挛度的定义相同. 每种方法在自己的纸张中定义的始终保持规则都保留在顶部. 三者都通过一个阈值设定预算, 所以对于我们的每个网格点, 我们预先在一组场景上测量, 其测量的伸缩度最接近的阈值, 并固定它; 目标伸缩度的最大残留值为 0.023 0.023 。

blocks.en: All three methods are designed for causal attention, whereas the global attention of 3D ViTs is bidirectional. We run all three without a causal mask and reinterpret every causality-dependent rule so that it keeps its intent under bidirectional attention. The antidiagonal score of XAttention is computed per block pair and does not depend on token order, and SpargeAttn calls the non-causal path already present in its official implementation. FlexPrefill has three causality-dependent rules, all listed in Tab. S5 .
blocks.zh: 这三种方法都是为了因果关注而设计的,而3D ViTs的全球关注是双向的. 我们运行所有三个没有因果面具,并重新解释每个因果依赖规则,使其意图受到双向关注。 XAttenty的反对角分数按区块对数计算,不取决于符号顺序,SpargeAttn称其正式执行中已经存在的非因果路径. FlexPrefill 有三个依赖因果关系的规则,都列在 Tab 中. 第5条.

blocks.en: All three methods are evaluated under a condition their papers do not cover: bidirectional sequences at the 10 5 10^{5} -token scale. Transferred literally, two of the three either fail to compress at all or operate on biased statistics. Table S5 lists every decision: each one favors the baseline, preserves the original rule’s intent, or, in one case, is marked as having no established direction. The gaps in Fig. S2 and Tab. S6 are therefore unlikely to be artifacts of the port.
blocks.zh: 所有三种方法都是在它们的文件不涵盖的条件下加以评价的:10 5 10^{5} -token比例尺的双向序列。 从字面上来说,三个中有两个要么完全没有压缩,要么在有偏见的统计数据上运作。 表S5列出了每个决定:每个决定都倾向于基准,保留原规则的意图,或者,在一个案例中,标记为没有既定方向。 Fig.S2和Tab中的漏洞. 因此S6不太可能是港口的文物.

blocks.en: Table S5: Porting decisions. Each row is a point where the original rule fails on 3D ViTs, together with our treatment; the parenthetical states whom the treatment favors, where this can be established. The favorable decisions are cases where, without the treatment, the baseline either could not be evaluated at all or would be penalized as an artifact of the port.
blocks.zh: 表S5:传送决定。 每行都是3D ViTs上原规则失败的点,加上我们的治疗;括号中写出治疗偏爱谁,可以确定这一点. 有利的决定是,在没有处理的情况下,根本无法评估基线,或者作为港口的文物受到处罚。

blocks.en: XAttention and FlexPrefill share one property: each sizes its mask by a threshold on attention probability mass alone, per query-block row for XAttention and per head over the whole block map for FlexPrefill, so beyond the common two-block floor, no row is guaranteed a budget. SparseVGGT instead fixes the count per row through its top- k k rule. On one scene, we measure the attention mass actually captured by masks of equal measured sparsity. XAttention matches SparseVGGT on average ( 0.820 0.820 vs. 0.819 0.819 ) but falls to 0.655 0.655 vs. 0.753 0.753 on the bottom 5 % 5\% of rows, so the loss concentrates on a few rows instead of spreading across queries.
blocks.zh: XAttention和FlexPrefillance共享一个属性:每个大小的面具,仅以注意力概率质量的阈值,XAttention的每个查询区块行和FlexPrefill的整块地图上的每个头,因此除了普通的两块楼层外,没有一行的预算保证. SparseVGGT 改为通过它的上- k k 规则修正每行的计数 。 在一个场景中,我们测量了 被同样量度的痉挛口罩 实际捕获的注意力量。 XAinting平均匹配SparseVGGT(0.820 0.820 vs. 0.819 0.819),但下降至0.655 0.655 vs. 0.753 0.753 下行5% 5\%,因此损失集中于几行而不是分散于查询.

blocks.en: G Porting Video Sparse Attention Baselines
blocks.zh: G 移植视频显示关注基线

blocks.en: Unlike the LLM family, the cost of this family lies in its variable block layouts and their mask construction, so we use the upstream kernel and harness exactly as released. The dense-step schedule has no counterpart in a single forward pass; the k-means warm start and the permutation are all kept as is, hyperparameters are the upstream defaults without retuning, and the only knob we sweep is the one each method exposes in the upstream scripts ( --sparsity for SVG, --top_p_kmeans for SVG2 and SVG-EAR). The one exception is the protected tokens: the block holding the camera/register tokens is placed in the upstream slot for context tokens and always kept, the same rule as for every other baseline in the paper.
blocks.zh: 与LLM家族不同的是,这个家族的成本在于其可变的块状布局和它们的面具构造,所以我们使用上游内核,并像释放的那样加以利用. 密集步表在单个前传中没有对应;k表示温暖的起动和常态都保持原样,超参数是上游的默认而不重调,我们扫荡的唯一的knob是每种方法在上游脚本中暴露出来的一个(-sparsity for SVG,-top_p_kmeans for SVG2和SVG-EAR). 一个例外是受保护的符号:持有相机/注册符号的块被放置在上游槽中,用于上下文符号,并始终保持,规则与纸张中所有其他基准相同.

blocks.en: The upstream implementation ships a separate mask definition per model family; of these, the Wan and HunyuanVideo variants are the candidates, and we use the latter. All variants share one formula that converts a target density into band widths after subtracting the cost of the always-kept context tokens; the formula is derived for the HunyuanVideo mask shape, and the Wan family, which has no context tokens, shares it only because that term vanishes. Measured elementwise on the VGGT/ScanNet++ shapes, the HunyuanVideo variant also hits the target density more accurately.
blocks.zh: 上游执行船每个模型家族都有一个单独的面具定义;其中Wan和HunyuanVideo变体是候选的,我们使用后者. 所有变体都有一个公式,将目标密度转换成波段宽度,再减去总是被保存的上下文符号的成本;该公式是为HunyuanVideo mask 形状而衍生的,而Wan家族没有上下文符号,仅仅因为这个术语消失而共享. 在VGGT/ScanNet++形状上测量元素,HunyuanVideo变体也更准确地击中目标密度.

blocks.en: Table S7: Latency against the k-means iteration count. VGGT, 100 100 views, RTX 4090. The SVG2 row is a linear fit over the sweep; dense and SparseVGGT do not depend on the iteration count, which confirms that the sweep touches nothing but k-means.
blocks.zh: 表S7:用k表示重迭计值的纬度。 VGGT,100100浏览,RTX 4090. SVG2行是覆盖扫荡的线性配位;稠密和SparseVGGT不依赖于迭代计数,这证实了扫荡除了k-意.

blocks.en: The upstream scripts ( --zero_step_kmeans_init ) run 50 50 iterations of k-means at the first denoising step of each layer, which is still a dense step, and 2 2 warm-started iterations at each of the remaining 49 49 steps, dense or sparse, an average of 2.96 2.96 iterations per step. VGGT has a single forward pass, so every global layer pays the full 50 50 iterations of cold k-means. The speedup of this family presupposes centroid reuse across denoising steps, and a single-pass reconstructor has no denominator to divide by. To confirm this, we sweep the iteration count directly and measure latency ( Tab. S7 ): the cost is exactly linear in the iteration count. The point is the intercept: applying the upstream amortized rate ( 2.96 2.96 iterations) gives 13.0 13.0 s, and even with k-means entirely free the latency is 12.40 12.40 s, both above the dense 10.47 10.47 s. The cost does not sit in k-means alone but in re-planning the variable block layout at every layer, and no adjustment of the iteration count closes this gap.
blocks.zh: 上游脚本(-zero_step_kmeans_init)在每层第一解密步骤上运行50个50个重联k-means,这仍然是一个密集步骤,其余49个步中,密度或稀疏的每个步上运行2个热启动重联,平均每步2.962.96个重联. VGGT有一个单向前传,所以每个全球层都支付全部50次重复的冷 k- means. 这个家族的加速预示着 中间机器人的再利用 跨越去诺斯舞步 单路重建器没有分母 为了确认这一点,我们直接扫描迭代计数,并测量纬度(Tab.S7):成本在迭代计数中是完全线性的. 要点是拦截:应用上游摊销率(2.96 2.96迭代)给出13.0 13.0s,即使有k-表示完全自由,延迟度为12.40 12.40s,均高于密集度10.47 10.47s. 成本并不单靠K表示,而是在重新规划每一层的可变块布局时,任何重迭计数的调整都不能弥补这一差距.
